description: This file defines a PHP class for the Bi-directional Text Module (Bdo) within an HTML Purifier library. The class extends a base module, sets up the 'bdo' element, and manages attributes related to text directionality.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Bdo
classes.description: Defines the specific behaviors and properties for the HTML 'bdo' element related to bi-directional text directionality.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the 'bdo' element, defines its attributes and transformations, and integrates it into the module's attribute collections.
